newsitem.title: USA: Network Connection sees second half profit.
newsitem.headline: Network Connection sees second half profit.

text.p: Network Connection Inc said Friday it believes it will see "significantly" higher revenues and a profitable second half of fiscal 1997 as a result of "long-term" business it built in the second quarter.
In the second quarter, the company said greater than expected customer delays in the startup of larger programs hurt its revenues and earnings.
The company reported a loss per share for the quarter of $0.27 compared to of $0.20 for the same period a year ago. Revenues wee $1.1 million compared to $1.5 million.

The company said its second quarter operating loss was the result of customer shipment delays for large orders and increased sales and marketing expenses related to the opening of a sales office in Singapore.
It also said the loss was the result of expanded sales efforts in the cruise line market and the introduction of Courseware on Demand, a pay-per-use training program.
